text:
lisa: Quick heads-up — there's a parcel in the lobby labeled 'Blue Willow Co — scented sampler'. It's leaking perfume, lobby smells strongly of jasmine. I moved it off the couch but it's still wafting around. Also we have 3 drop-in visitors at 3pm and only two guest chairs free. @frontdesk can you stash the box and confirm badge status? Also tiny sidebar: who's playing hotdesk bingo this week? :eyes:
frontdesk: Front desk — saw the box, it's in the package shelf by the lockers now. Label says 'samples - do not crush'. I put on gloves and double-bagged the loose inserts. Badge for Maya R is printed and waiting. I'll keep the jasmine box in the back until we figure safe disposal. :package:
omar: Thanks for catching that. Heads-up — one of the 3pm visitors needs wheelchair access. Can we reserve the accessible spot near the window?
amy: Reserved the accessible chair by the window for Priya. Also moved one extra folding chair from the cafe. :chair:
chris: Hotdesk bingo — I'm in. Claiming A2 for the week. Prize suggestion: winner gets to pick the snack box for Friday. :trophy:
lisa: Love the snack prize. Also can someone check with facilities about a scent-safe trash for those demo candles? Don't want allergic folks to be stuck.
frontdesk: Noted — pinging facilities now. In the meantime I'm putting an 'odor watch' sign by the lobby and a mask on the package. If facilities can't take it, I'll mark it for courier return.
maya: FYI the visiting Blue Willow rep said they're dropping off the samples for a meeting in conf B, so it's probably theirs. I'll meet them at 3 to collect badges if needed.
hr-ops: Quick reminder — if visitors need escort beyond the lobby, escort policy still applies. Volunteers? :wave:
jordan: I can escort the 3pm group from lobby to conf B. Also happy to lob a jasmine-free donut to the hotdesk bingo winner.
amy: Poll: who wants first pick of hotdesks this week? React with :one: for Lisa, :two: for Jordan, :three: for Chris, :four: for whoever brings donuts. (we'll call this emergency office moral enforcement)
chris: :four: incoming — will bring donuts. Also anyone allergic to jasmine please DM me and we'll seat accordingly.
frontdesk: Facilities responded — they'll take the box if we put it in the marked hazardous-return bin by 3:15pm. I'll coordinate pickup.
lisa: Thanks everyone. I'll be the official jasmine neutralizer if needed. :sweat_smile: See you at 3pm.
